figures.subject: THE RETURNING TRACE

source.brief_excerpt: Returning Trace — bird and ring, interrupted assembly that returns.

figures.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE standalone raster figure reference for Librum Quinque, not a complete plate.
Input image 1 is approved FORAS: DRAWING HAND AND PALETTE ONLY, not its identity, six arms or pose. Input image 2 is this subject's ORIGINAL SOL PLATE: SUBJECT IDENTITY, anatomy, silhouette and pose ONLY. Re-render that subject in the common Foras fine pen hand. Do not copy the old plate's lettering, page framing, diagrams, marginal registers, panel crops, broad red veins or paper texture.
Fine near-black #161918 engraving/pen line, dense cellular and lattice ornament with cream voids, fine stroke bundles, delicate vertical black drop-lines with tiny terminal dots. Sparse muted slate #4f6f7a and a little ochre only other hues beyond near-black and the ONE specified red intervention.
Flat unbleached cream #ede6d4 ground edge to edge, no texture gradient, vignette, cast shadow or background scene. Whole subject centred and completely visible with generous blank air on every side, about 75-80 percent canvas height and width. Fine lineart with light flat wash at most: no painted shading, realistic lighting, glossy reflection or 3D render.
RED TARGET: sRGB #a32b24, RGB(163,43,36), actual uniform red stroke core, no orange, bright scarlet, dark crimson, highlight or shadow. Red only in the single intervention specified below; all eyes, mouths, body membranes and other linework near-black/cream with sparse slate/ochre. Antialias edges only.
NO text whatsoever, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, symbols used as writing, captions, borders, page frame, watermark, side diagrams or extra figures. Any ring or handheld frame is the subject's own body/prop, never an image border. All unoccupied centres plain cream.

NEW SUBJECT — THE RETURNING TRACE — ORIGINAL SOL BIRD AND RING, mapped to Graduum II. Preserve the original ONE bird-shaped cellular body curving around a large circular EMPTY RING: recognisable hawklike head at upper right, swept-back feather crest, fine hooked beak, dark engraved eye; one whole organic neck and breast/wing run down the right side of the ring, becoming fine branching tail filaments below. The left half of the ring retains the original more ordered layered bands, entirely near-black/cream, no pseudo-script, keyboard-like marks or numeral ticks. The big centre stays completely empty cream, no object or symbol inside. Do not add a second head, body, ring or background moon. ONE RED INTERVENTION: a single fine incomplete returning arc along a short stretch of the INNER LOWER-LEFT ring edge, ending before it rejoins, no red nodes or separate thread. All old red veins and red lettering are removed. Cellular bird anatomy and mechanical ring share one drawing hand, small slate/ochre pockets only. Square PNG 1:1, target 2048 x 2048 if available, complete crest, ring and tail in generous cream margin.
